purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The national court page documents land-registration procedures and multi-state offices; the national spatial portal describes WMS/WFS. No East Darfur/Ad Da'ein cadastral layer, local office, parcel identifier, or full geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: The official Sudan Judiciary describes a national land-registration administration with offices across the states and formal land-registration procedures, but the available official directory material does not identify an Ad Da'ein/East Darfur office. The National Spatial Portal advertises WMS/WFS; its linked portal did not load through the available read-only fetch path and no cadastral layer was confirmed.
